name: Validate Backend Activity Storage
description: Validate that metabob-rpc-api correctly stores, retrieves, and manages activity templates with Thompson Sampling

task_steps.description: Prepare a test activity template for validation
Test template registration via backend API

prompt.template:
# Task: Test Template Registration

## Previous Task Output
{{prepareOutput}}

Template file: {{prepareOutput.templatePath}}

## Backend URL
{{backendUrl}}

## Your Task
Test that templates can be registered and stored in the backend.

### Step 1: Register Template
Use the CLI or direct API call to register the template:

```bash
# Option 1: Via metabob-cli
cd repos/metabob-cli
python -m metabob_cli.activities.register --file {{prepareOutput.templatePath}}

# Option 2: Direct API call
curl -X POST {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/templates \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @{{prepareOutput.templatePath}}
```

### Step 2: Verify Storage
Retrieve the template to verify it was stored:

```bash
curl {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/templates/{{prepareOutput.templateId}}
```

### Step 3: Validate Response
Check that the response contains:
- ✅ All tasks (2 tasks)
- ✅ Task dependencies (task-2 depends on task-1)
- ✅ Variables (testParam)
- ✅ Validation rules
- ✅ Retry strategies

## Output Format
```json
{
  "registration": {
    "success": true/false,
    "method": "cli|api",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "templateId": "validate-backend-test-template"
  },
  "retrieval": {
    "success": true/false,
    "tasksCount": 2,
    "variablesCount": 1,
    "allFieldsPresent": true/false
  },
  "validation": {
    "passed": true/false,
    "issues": ["list any issues found"]
  }
}
```

## Success Criteria
- Template registered successfully (HTTP 200)
- Template retrievable by ID
- All fields preserved (tasks, variables, validation)
- No data corruption

# Task: Test Thompson Sampling

## Backend URL
{{backendUrl}}

## Template ID
{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}

## Your Task
Validate that Thompson Sampling works for variant selection.

### Step 1: Create Template Variant
Create a variant of the test template:

```bash
curl -X POST {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/templates/{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}/variants \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "reason": "Test variant for validation",
    "changes": {
      "tasks": [
        {
          "id": "task-1",
          "prompt": {
            "template": "Variant task 1: {{testParam}}"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```

### Step 2: Test Variant Selection
Request variant selection multiple times:

```bash
for i in {1..5}; do
  curl -X POST {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/templates/{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}/select-variant
done
```

### Step 3: Record Execution Results
Simulate 2 successes for variant A, 1 failure for variant B:

```bash
# Success for variant A
curl -X POST {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/executions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "template_id": "{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}",
    "variant_id": "base",
    "success": true,
    "cost": 0.01,
    "duration": 5000
  }'

# Repeat success
curl -X POST {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/executions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "template_id": "{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}",
    "variant_id": "base",
    "success": true,
    "cost": 0.01,
    "duration": 4500
  }'

# Failure for variant (if exists)
curl -X POST {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/executions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "template_id": "{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}",
    "variant_id": "variant-1",
    "success": false,
    "cost": 0.005,
    "duration": 2000
  }'
```

### Step 4: Verify Learning
Check that Thompson Sampling probabilities shifted:

```bash
curl {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/templates/{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}/stats
```

Expected: Base variant should have higher probability after 2 successes vs 1 failure

## Output Format
```json
{
  "variantCreation": {
    "success": true/false,
    "variantId": "variant-1"
  },
  "sampling": {
    "selections": [
      {"variantId": "base", "confidence": 0.7},
      {"variantId": "variant-1", "confidence": 0.3}
    ],
    "distributionReasonable": true/false
  },
  "learning": {
    "executionsRecorded": 3,
    "baseAlpha": "value after 2 successes",
    "baseBeta": "value (should be unchanged or minimal)",
    "probabilityShift": "base variant favored after successes"
  },
  "validation": {
    "passed": true/false,
    "issues": []
  }
}
```

## Success Criteria
- Variants can be created
- Selection returns variant IDs
- Execution results recorded
- Learning updates alpha/beta
- Probabilities shift based on outcomes

task_steps.description: Clean up test template and data

prompt.template:
# Task: Cleanup Test Data

## Your Task
Clean up the test template and execution data.

### Delete Test Template
```bash
curl -X DELETE {{backendUrl}}/v2/activities/templates/{{registrationOutput.registration.templateId}}
```

### Remove Test File
```bash
rm -f {{prepareOutput.templatePath}}
rmdir test-templates 2>/dev/null || true
```

## Output
```json
{
  "cleanup": {
    "templateDeleted": true,
    "fileRemoved": true
  }
}
```
